question: Что такое Normalization и как это работает?
short_answer: Normalization structures relations to reduce duplicated facts and update anomalies; Junior depth focuses on practical 1NF–3NF intuition.
junior_answer: Normalization structures relations to reduce duplicated facts and update anomalies; Junior depth focuses on practical 1NF–3NF intuition. Важное ограничение: Normalization is not maximum table count; boundaries follow data meaning and update dependencies.
